resources.string: How do I get playlist updates?
To receive playlist updates you must:
• Complete a playlist form and turn it in by Tuesday night.
• Turn in your MP3 player by Tuesday night.
How do I get a playlist form?
Ask staff for a playlist form.
In order to receive playlist updates you must turn your MP3 player in to staff by Tuesday night.
What if something is wrong with my device?
If you get logged out of your music or if your MP3 player is not operating properly, turn it into staff and let them know what\'s happening with your device.
